events.credibility_reason: Source never located; scope known only from secondary summaries.
Source never located; secondary descriptions disagree on what is proved.
One construction reportedly erroneous, corrected only in Chang and Sun 2024.
Main result conditional on two unproved conjectures; proofs had gaps found during AI checking, no independent review.

why: Chang and Sun (GD 2024, refereed LIPIcs) settle the 4-regular class: a case, digested by acceptance into refereed proceedings. Förster et al. treat trees and cacti, for which integer-length plane drawings are elementary; the paper's contribution is grid size with integer coordinates, a stronger/changed question, so variant. Kintali's unconditional content is a lemma and the main theorem is a reduction to unproved conjectures: none. Kemnitz–Harborth's maximal-planar construction is a reduction (subgraphs inherit drawings), so none, not a case. Platonic-graph drawings are finitely many instances. Kintali's AI disclosure names no system and describes verification, gap-finding, prose and unspecified examples; nothing identifies AI-produced mathematics in the result, so none.
doubts: Chang–Sun slides reportedly claim all max-degree-4 graphs are covered; still a case either way. Kintali's 'some examples were generated by AI' is unspecified; if they fed the lemma it would still be a none-scope event. Pre-snapshot class results (Biedl, Benediktovich) rest on unlocated sources.
